Class Ui

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.swing.ui.Ui
@ViewScoped public final class Ui extends Object
What a view needs to build its components. Every method is called on the EDT, and every subscription it makes belongs to its view's scope.

    Shows an observable list in a list, as bind(JList, ObservableList, Function) does, and keeps its single selection and a property in step: a user's selection sets the property, and a change of the property selects its value, or clears the selection for an empty value or one that isn't in the list, then setting the property to empty.

      Shows an observable list in a list, as bind(JList, ObservableList, Function) does, and keeps its single selection and a property in step: a user's selection sets the property, and a change of the property selects its value, or clears the selection for an empty value or one that isn't in the list, then setting the property to empty.       selection - the selected element, empty when nothing is selected
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if an argument is null
      IllegalStateException - if the list is already bound

    • bind

      public <E> void bind(JTable table, ObservableList<E> rows, List<Column<E,?>> columns)
      Shows an observable list in a table, a row per element and a column per Column, in order: sets a new model on the table, which follows the observable list change by change on the EDT, and whose model index of a column is its position in columns. The table has no row sorter, so a view index of a row is its index in the list. Its columns exist when this method returns, so that a table bound in content() has its order and widths restored with the window state. The subscription belongs to the view's scope.
      Type Parameters:
      E - the type of the rows
      Parameters:
      table - the table
      rows - the rows, made by ObservableList.of(Object[]) or ObservableList.copyOf(Collection)
      columns - the columns, in order
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if an argument or a column is null
      IllegalStateException - if the table is already bound

    • every

      public Subscription every(Duration period, Runnable action)
      Runs an action on the EDT every period, the first time one period after the call, until the returned subscription or this view's scope is closed. The period is measured with the Ticker bean; a late run doesn't make up for the runs it missed: the next one comes one period after it. An exception thrown by the action goes to the FailureHandler, and the action keeps its schedule; an Error is not caught.
      Parameters:
      period - the period
      action - the action
      Returns:
      the subscription, which stops the action when closed
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if period or action is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the period is not positive
      IllegalStateException - if this view's scope is closed
